title: Streaming and Asynchronous Utilities
summary: This module provides utilities for streaming program outputs and managing asynchronous execution within DSPy, enabling real-time feedback and non-blocking operations.

nodes.label: Streamify Program Output
nodes.title: Streamify Program Output
nodes.description: Wraps a DSPy program to stream its outputs incrementally, providing status messages and handling stream listeners for specific fields.

nodes.label: Manage Stream Listeners
nodes.title: Manage Stream Listeners
nodes.description: Listens to the output stream of a specific field within a predictor, capturing and processing chunks based on adapter configurations.

nodes.label: Execute Program Asynchronously
nodes.title: Execute Program Asynchronously
nodes.description: Wraps a synchronous program to allow its execution in an asynchronous context, managing thread-local overrides and concurrency limits.

nodes.label: Synchronous Wrapper for Async
nodes.title: Synchronous Wrapper for Async
nodes.description: Provides a synchronous interface for an asynchronous DSPy program, allowing it to be called from synchronous contexts.

nodes.label: Run in New Event Loop
nodes.title: Run in New Event Loop
nodes.description: Executes an asynchronous function within a newly created and managed asyncio event loop, ensuring isolation.

nodes.label: Get Concurrency Limiter
nodes.title: Get Concurrency Limiter
nodes.description: Retrieves or initializes a concurrency limiter to control the number of concurrent asynchronous operations.

nodes.label: Format Streaming Response
nodes.title: Format Streaming Response
nodes.description: Converts DSPy program output streams into an OpenAI-compatible streaming response format for API consumption.

groups.label: Core Streaming Logic
groups.title: Core Streaming Logic
groups.description: Components responsible for enabling and managing incremental output streaming from DSPy programs.

groups.label: Asynchronous Execution
groups.title: Asynchronous Execution Management
groups.description: Utilities for converting and managing synchronous and asynchronous program execution flows.
